name: update_task

user_id.description: UUID of the user who owns the task

task_id.description: UUID of the task to update

input_schema.note: At least one of 'title' or 'description' must be provided

description.description: Updated description of the task (may be null)

updated_at.description: When the task was last updated

error_codes.message: Task with the specified ID does not exist
User does not own this task
Input validation failed (title too long, empty, etc.)
No title or description provided for update
Failed to update task due to database error

notes: This tool only updates title and description
To change task status, use complete_task tool
Other fields (priority, due_date, tags) are not modified by this tool
